ways.label: Waingongoro Hut from Dawson Falls
evidence: Follow the Wilkies Pool Loop Track from just above the visitor centre, rock hopping across the Kapuni Stream.
Follow this downhill, past the 24 m high Waingongoro swing bridge, to the hut.
Return the same way or via Wilkies Pools.

ways.label: Waingongoro Hut from East Egmont
evidence: From Ngāti Ruanui Stratford Mountain House, the track crosses several unbridged streams before reaching the Waingongoro swing bridge.
Across the bridge a short track leads down to the hut.

doubts: No road end feature matches the Wilkies Pool Loop Track start 'just above the visitor centre' at Dawson Falls, nor Stratford Mountain House at East Egmont, so both starts have no ref. The Dawson Falls way may also be returned 'via Wilkies Pools' (a partial loop); it is recorded as out and back. The Kapuni Loop Track entrance (50 m down Manaia Road) is the alternate access when Kapuni Stream is impassable.
